turns.text: Hey Lloyd, can you check if the new coffee maker arrived?
I don't have access to your real-time shipping notifications, but I can check your email if you've connected your account. Did you receive a tracking number?
Not yet. I'll check later. Also, I'm reviewing some new ML papers. Specifically looking at ANCL.
Interesting. Do you have a link to the paper or are you reading it from memory?
I'm looking at the preprint now. It's interesting because ANCL is derived from published CVPR/ICLR papers.
Ah, so it builds on existing conference work. That makes sense for a new method.
Yeah. Anyway, back to the coffee maker. If it's not here by Friday, I'm returning it.
Understood. I'll remind you to check the status tomorrow afternoon.
Lloyd, my kitchen sink is leaking again. Any quick fixes?
First, try tightening the nut under the sink. If that doesn't work, it might be the washer. Do you have a wrench handy?
I do. I'll try that. While I wait for the plumber, I'm continuing to read about ANCL.
How is the reading going? Did you find anything else noteworthy?
Yes. I realized ANCL achieves a better stability-plasticity trade-off via a dual-network stability/plasticity separation.
That sounds like a robust approach to handling catastrophic forgetting. Thanks for sharing that detail.
It is. Okay, the wrench didn't help. I'm calling the plumber now.
Good idea. Let me know if you need help finding a good service provider.
